e.summary_hk: ILF 曲線與超額定價（burning-cost，PyPI 0.1.0）：MBBEFD 曝光曲線、增額損失因子、per-risk XL 定價
e.body: insurance-ilf（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.0）做限额与超额定价：MBBEFD 曝光曲线拟合（Swiss Re 家族）、增额损失因子（ILF）表、per-risk 超额损失（XL）定价——英国一般保险。对 RIAA：ILF/曝光曲线是责任险与再保险定价的核心工具——「限额越高、费率密度越低」由曝光曲线量化；MBBEFD 是行业标准参数族（Swiss Re 经典）；与 [[insurance-severity]]（限额损失分布）、[[reinsurance]]（再保险视角）配套；传统精算方法在费率手册中的直接体现。
e.body_en: insurance-ilf (burning-cost, PyPI v0.1.0) does limit and excess pricing: MBBEFD exposure curve fitting ([[swiss-re|Swiss Re]] families), increased limit factor (ILF) tables, per-risk excess of loss (XL) pricing — UK general insurance. For RIAA: ILF/exposure curves are core to liability and reinsurance pricing — 'higher limits, lower rate density' is quantified by exposure curves; MBBEFD is the industry-standard parametric family (classic Swiss Re); pairs with [[insurance-severity]] (limited loss distributions) and [[reinsurance]] (reinsurance view); the direct embodiment of classical actuarial methods in rating manuals.
e.body_hk: insurance-ilf（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.0）做限額與超額定價：MBBEFD 曝光曲線擬合（Swiss Re 家族）、增額損失因子（ILF）表、per-risk 超額損失（XL）定價——英國一般保險。對 RIAA：ILF/曝光曲線是責任險與再保險定價的核心工具——「限額越高、費率密度越低」由曝光曲線量化；MBBEFD 是行業標準參數族（Swiss Re 經典）；與 [[insurance-severity]]（限額損失分佈）、[[reinsurance]]（再保險視角）配套；傳統精算方法在費率手冊中的直接體現。
